note: Shared golden cases for the session trailer parser. Two copies exist and must stay identical: DevDelta internal/client/commitlink/testdata/session_trailers.json (writer side, ExtractSessionIDs) and DevLake backend/plugins/kiro/tasks/testdata/session_trailers.json (reader side, ParseSessionTrailers). A commit message is parsed on both ends with the same loose, line-anchored regex; a case added here must be added to the twin file in the same change.
